session_read: A full reconciliation against INDmoney's transaction-confirmation emails found 12 trades today, not the 7 caught by holdings-snapshot diffing -- QCOM was stopped out then bought back same day, GLW was re-entered after its full 07-24 exit, and MKSI is a brand-new position, none of which a qty-diff detector run mid-session could ever see. Book is now 26 positions, cash correctly back in the normal band at 11.5% after fixing a regime-persistence bug, and aggregate open risk sits at 12.1% against a 10% budget -- worse than before reconciliation, not better, since more capital went out than the partial picture showed.
